description: Sends the user's quote request (name, email, optional phone, service location, preferred time) to the chosen business. Called by the quote form only.

consent.description: Required. Before you call this tool, show the user this exact text and get their agreement: "I agree to Booqer's Terms and Privacy Policy and consent to Booqer sharing my request with this shop so they can contact me about it." Terms: https://booqer.ai/terms. Privacy Policy: https://booqer.ai/privacy. Set true only after the user agrees. Without consent true the call is rejected and nothing is stored.

email.description: Customer email on a real domain. Example: ada@gmail.com.

offering.description: Service id from get_business. Example: project_consult.

phone.description: Customer phone. Optional when an email is present. Example: 3525550100.

service_address.description: Street address. Optional for a phone consult. Required for an on-site visit. Example: 100 Demo Drive, Clermont FL 34711.

start.description: Preferred time as an ISO-8601 timestamp. Example: 2026-10-21T14:00:00-04:00.

name: submit_service_request

outputSchema.description: stored is true when the request was saved.

title: Submit a service request
